alex_infra: FYI vendor just updated lead times for the APAC H100 top-up — they're quoting ~24 weeks for full allocation, but offered a 3-wave split. need quick decision on accept vs look for alternatives.
mark_nexasupply: sorry for the churn, factory allocation shift. can do 6 units within 4 weeks, then 8 in week 14, final 10 in week 24. can consolidate docs / single commercial invoice, but customs in AU/NZ may still split manifests. insurance +5% optional.
maya_ops: split is fine if we can get depot-swap option for DOAs and pre-issued AWBs so field teams can schedule installs. partial batches arriving without depot swap = operational risk.
sanjay_planning: re: capacity, ANZ cluster needs 12 units by week 10 to avoid throttling. If we take 6 now + expedited 6 in week 10 that'd be ideal. can vendor re-prioritize the week 14 batch?
mark_nexasupply: we can reprioritize 6 from the week-14 batch to week-10 if you accept an air uplift on that tranche (surcharge estimate +12%). requires confirmed PO amendment by EOD.
josh_ops: need clarity on serial handling. last time mixed batches caused serial mismatch and prolonged RMA because temporary IDs weren't tracked. we need: pre-shipment serial list, AWB, and `TEMP-IDs` scheme if customs blocks live serials.
mark_nexasupply: agree. we'll provide CSV of serials 48h before ship and pre-issue AWB numbers. for APAC we may use `TEMP-APAC-####` placeholders; full serials released at customs clear.
ops-bot: Deploy ticket INF-2783 created to track incoming wave scheduling and install windows. Link: https://redwood.internal/tickets/INF-2783 :spiral_calendar:
alex_infra: Also need RMA SLA commitments for DOA. previous SLA (7-21 days) is too loose for our SLAs. can vendor commit to 5 business days depot swap for APAC hubs (SG, SYD)?
mark_nexasupply: depot swap in SG yes (5 biz days). SYD depends on local carrier — we can target 7 biz days for SYD. EU/US still 3 biz days depot swap.
maya_ops: ok confirm in writing and add credit for extended lead time — propose 2% credit on delayed tranche and waive part of the air uplift if we confirm reorder for remaining allocation.
mark_nexasupply: will draft amendment: (a) 5bd depot swap SG, 7bd SYD, (b) 2% tranche delay credit, (c) air uplift waiver up to 6 units if PO amendment signed today.
sanjay_planning: i'll sign PO amendment if mark posts the amendment to our procurement thread by 18:00 PST. we need proforma AWB samples to validate customs classification — HS code mismatch last time added 10 days.
mark_nexasupply: uploading draft amendment and sample AWB + HS code to the procurement doc now. AWB sample: AWB123456789AU. HS code proposed: 847330 — please confirm.
josh_ops: Confirm HS 847330 ok for customs counsel? looping in legal if any compliance risk.
ops-bot: Reminder: create RMA playbook update task INF-2783-1 for TEMP-ID reconciliation and crossdock procedure.
alex_infra: Sounds like next steps: vendor posts amendment + AWB samples, procurement signs PO amend by EOD to secure week-10 uplift, ops gets serial CSV 48h pre-ship, we add RMA playbook task. thumbs if agreed. :thumbsup:
mark_nexasupply: acknowledged. posting docs now. thanks all.
maya_ops: :thumbsup: scheduling field teams for tentative week-4 install for first tranche.
sanjay_planning: signed once amendment is updated. will confirm in thread.
ops-bot: Thread closed for now, reopen when amendment uploaded.
